title: A stale export-required report is an operational hold, never a prose failure.
purpose: When a report exists but its prose_hash / packet fingerprint / draft_attempt does not match the current scene, production triage MUST raise an incomplete-evaluation operational hold and MUST NOT project a prose Critique or verify/clear an existing Issue (ADR 0010/0022/0019).

clauses.statement: The exit the POV reaches for is spatially reachable from where the scene places her.

satisfaction_criterion.statement: Prose establishes an unobstructed path from the POV's position to the exit before she uses it.
